---
name: VetGest medical content conventions
description: Apply to veterinary educational content, alert rules, care guidance, and pregnancy phase data.
applyTo: "src/**/Content/**/*.cs,src/**/Content/**/*.json,docs/medical/**/*.md"
---

- Treat content as educational guidance, never as diagnosis or a substitute for veterinary care.
- Identify species, evidence scope, review status, reviewer, and review date.
- State uncertainty for gestational dates and distinguish mating-based from ovulation-based estimates.
- Require veterinary review before publishing alerts or care guidance.
- Emergency content must recommend immediate veterinary contact and must not teach invasive home procedures.
